toplevel.title: General Settings
toplevel.context_window_desc: Default context window used when taking over Claude Code / Codex; auto-compaction triggers at ~90%. Defaults to 200000 — a larger window is not always better (higher cost and more context drift). To set a value above 200000, you must also enable 'Extended Context (1M)' for the corresponding model family in the router (appends [1m] to the model name); otherwise Claude Code caps it at 200000 and the setting has no effect.
toplevel.context_window_warn: Value exceeds 200000 but the model family's 'Extended Context (1M)' is not enabled. Claude Code caps it at 200000, so this setting won't take effect — enable Extended Context in the router.
toplevel.probe_timeout_desc: Hard timeout for background provider reachability probes. Default 15000.
toplevel.probe_slow_threshold_desc: When a provider probe takes longer than this, the UI shows a yellow slow-network warning. Affects UI cues only, not routing or the circuit breaker. Default 3000.

providers.proxy_tooltip_no_url: Configure a proxy URL in General settings first
providers.default_thinking_level_tooltip: Injected when the client request carries no thinking config, auto-converted per endpoint type: Anthropic /v1/messages → output_config.effort (the field current Anthropic models and Anthropic-compatible endpoints such as GLM actually read) together with thinking.budget_tokens; OpenAI /v1/responses → reasoning.effort; OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions → reasoning_effort. A client-set level (including output_config.effort) always wins. Pick "Custom" for a free-form provider value or a token budget.
providers.default_thinking_level_custom_hint: Non-enum strings pass through verbatim on OpenAI-style endpoints (/v1/responses, chat completions, e.g. minimal); on Anthropic endpoints they resolve to the standard level they stand for: min/minimal/light→low, xhigh/maximum/ultra→max, anything else is ignored; a pure number is injected as an exact token budget on Anthropic endpoints (below 1024 raised to the API minimum) with the tier derived from it. The max tier sends only the 32768 budget on Anthropic endpoints — upstream only the newest Opus accepts effort=max, while the providers that do (GLM) already default to it.

router.title: Router
router.enableExtendedContextDesc: Append [1m] to the Claude Code model name for 1M context window support. Only when enabled can the top-level 'Context Window' be set above 200000 (e.g. 400000) — Claude Code then caps it at 1M and compaction triggers at the configured value; without this, any value above 200000 is capped back to 200000.
router.family_routing_desc: Route opus/sonnet/haiku model families to different providers and models
router.concurrency_threshold_hint: New sessions overflow to the scenario's fallback list once the selected model's concurrency reaches this value (default: 3)
router.provider_disabled_warning: ⚠️ This provider is disabled. Please select a different model.

settings.disable_attribution_header: Strip Claude Code Attribution Header (improves prompt-cache hit rate)
settings.fallback_description: When the primary model fails, try these fallback models in order.
settings.concurrency_priority_description: Layers on top of the normal routing decision: once the selected model's in-flight concurrency reaches the threshold, requests from new (not yet pinned) sessions overflow to the least-loaded model in that scenario's fallback list; already-pinned sessions are unaffected. Each scenario of a session (default/think/longContext ...) sticks to its initially assigned model and only switches when the current model errors and error-fallback succeeds (requires Fallback Configuration).
settings.proxy_global_hint_on: All providers use this proxy address
settings.proxy_global_hint_off: Only providers with proxy enabled use this address
settings.proxy_global_hint_empty: No proxy address configured; all providers connect directly
settings.proxy_alias_hint: The active proxy comes from a compatibility key (e.g. HTTPS_PROXY), not the field above.
settings.proxy_security_hint: The proxy can see API keys and request payloads — only configure a trusted proxy.
settings.proxy_invalid_message: The proxy URL is invalid. Only http://, https://, empty values, or $VAR placeholders are allowed. The server will reject this config (HTTP 400) if saved now.

projects.ccr_takeover_desc: When enabled, this project's Claude Code CLI routes requests through ccr by writing ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN into .claude/settings.local.json.
projects.takeover_clients_desc: Choose which clients this project takes over; only Claude Code is taken over by default. pi / Qwen Code / opencode are opt-in (they write config files such as .pi/settings.json, .qwen/settings.json and opencode.json into the project directory). workbuddy.description_short: Browser-authorized subscription provider managed by CCR.
workbuddy.description: Authorize your WorkBuddy subscription — CN or international (WorkBuddy AI) — in the browser and register discovered models. No desktop app, plugin or extra gateway is required. This manages a provider, not client takeover.
workbuddy.server_host: “Local” means the computer running the CCR server, not this browser’s computer.
workbuddy.privacy: Enter your password only on the official authorization page. CCR stores credentials only in its private server file (0600), never in this browser or ordinary provider configuration. Tokens are sent only to the selected fixed WorkBuddy origin for discovery and inference.
workbuddy.backup_warning: Configuration backups do not include credentials. Authorize again after restoring a backup.
workbuddy.encrypted_warning: Encrypted desktop login files are not decrypted and are unsupported. CCR does not refresh tokens: sign in again in WorkBuddy and re-import when expired.
workbuddy.routing_note: Login, import, sync and disconnect never change Router or select a default model. Only explicitly hiding a model clears the Router references that point at it. Choose workbuddy,<model> manually.
workbuddy.import_title: Import {{site}} login on the CCR server?
workbuddy.import_warning: This reads the fixed desktop login file of the selected site once on the CCR server and sends the access token only to that site's fixed origin to discover models. The source file is never modified. No arbitrary path or token input is accepted. If the saved token is near expiry, this same explicit import additionally grants one bounded re-read of the same site + account login, used in memory only. CCR never calls a refresh API.
workbuddy.consent: I consent to CCR importing this server's {{site}} login, sending the token only to that site's fixed origin, and — when near expiry — one bounded same-site, same-account re-read in memory only.
workbuddy.disconnect_warning: Only CCR’s private login state and its managed provider will be deleted. Your WorkBuddy desktop login will not be modified. Router references are preserved and may no longer work; update them manually. No default route will be changed for you.
workbuddy.disconnected: WorkBuddy disconnected. Router references were preserved; update them manually.
workbuddy.account_added: New account added: this site now has {{count}} account(s) in CCR. This was a new account, not a duplicate. To add another one, sign in on the official site with a different account.
workbuddy.account_updated: Existing account updated (not a duplicate): this site has {{count}} account(s) in CCR. To add another one, sign in on the official site with a different account.
workbuddy.other_edit: Finish the current provider edit/save before managing WorkBuddy.
workbuddy.managed_notice: Manage WorkBuddy in Settings → Providers. Generic edit/delete cannot change its name, URL, credentials or transformer. Use Disconnect here to remove it; Router is unchanged.

help.expired: Authorize again in the browser. For desktop-imported logins, renew in the desktop app before explicitly re-importing.
help.sealed: Encrypted desktop login files are unsupported. Nothing in the source login file is modified.
help.source_missing: The optional desktop source is missing. You can authorize directly in the browser instead.
help.source_changed: Explicitly re-import to update CCR’s saved account. CCR does not monitor desktop account changes.
help.error: The connection is not ready. Review the error and retry explicitly.

errors.sealed: WorkBuddy encrypted its local login state (newer desktop versions). Import is unsupported; CCR will not decrypt it. Existing login and models are preserved.
errors.source_missing: No WorkBuddy login file was found at the fixed path on the CCR server. Sign in using WorkBuddy there, then retry.
errors.source_invalid: The server’s WorkBuddy login file is invalid or unsupported. Sign in in WorkBuddy again and retry. Existing models are preserved.
errors.models_fetch_failed: Model discovery failed or returned no models. Previous models are preserved. Retry sync or authorize again.
errors.workbuddy_name_conflict: An ordinary provider named “workbuddy” already exists. Rename or remove it before authorization; CCR will not take it over.
errors.workbuddy_not_connected: WorkBuddy is not connected. Authorize in the browser first.
errors.request_failed: WorkBuddy management failed. No success was confirmed. Existing model details remain visible; retry explicitly.
errors.workbuddy_unauthorized: This browser was rejected by the local-machine check. WorkBuddy management only works on the computer running the CCR service, via http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost on the service port. Open the UI there and try again.
errors.restricted: WorkBuddy restricted this account (11140). Stop retrying and use Submit feedback inside WorkBuddy to appeal.
errors.channel_rejected: WorkBuddy rejected this client channel. Use another client or provider; CCR does not rewrite prompts to bypass this restriction.
errors.busy: A configuration save or another WorkBuddy action is in progress. Wait for it to finish and retry.
errors.login_state_rejected: Authorization was rejected or the login state is invalid. Start a new login.
errors.login_account_failed: Unable to confirm the authorized account. Start a new login.
errors.login_persist_failed: Unable to save the authorized login privately. Check the CCR server and retry.
errors.login_expired: This authorization attempt expired. Start a new login.
errors.workbuddy_account_not_found: That WorkBuddy account no longer exists in this site's pool. Refresh the list and pick an account again.
errors.workbuddy_model_invalid: The model id was rejected. Model ids cannot be empty, longer than 256 characters, or contain a comma. Retry with a different model.
errors.workbuddy_config_write_failed: The change was rolled back because the configuration could not be saved. Check the CCR server config and retry.
errors.workbuddy_login_busy: Too many WorkBuddy authorization attempts are running. Wait for them to finish and start again.

workbuddy.renewal_desktop: Renewal mode: desktop. Sign in again in the WorkBuddy desktop app and re-import here when expired. CCR calls no credential-refresh API and stores no refresh credential.
workbuddy.images_unsupported: On the international site, these GLM models may report image support but the server can drop image content: {{models}}. Use another model for important image tasks.

site.label: Which WorkBuddy site should be authorized?
site.privacy: The access token is sent only to the fixed origin of the selected site: {{site}}. It never reaches this browser or the ordinary provider configuration.

workbuddy.browser_source: Browser authorization is managed and renewed by CCR. Optional desktop imports are a separate source: shared desktop refresh credentials are never copied or used by CCR.
workbuddy.login_pending: Waiting for authorization. Open the official page below and finish signing in. This attempt ends after at most five minutes.
workbuddy.renewal_browser: Renewal mode: browser. CCR privately stores and refreshes this browser-owned login. Authorize again if renewal fails.
workbuddy.account_remove_warning: Only the account’s private login state is removed from this site’s pool. Its Router references are preserved and may stop working. Removing the active account falls back to the earliest remaining account; removing the last account disconnects this site.
workbuddy.restored_toast: Restored {{model}}. Router references were not rewritten.
workbuddy.restored_all_toast: Restored {{count}} hidden models. Router references were not rewritten.
workbuddy.hidden_note: Hidden models stay hidden across sync and re-authorization and are excluded from the managed provider; restore them here at any time.

geminiOauth.title: Gemini (Antigravity) subscription
geminiOauth.description: Sign in with a Google account that has an Antigravity / Code Assist subscription and use its Gemini models through CCR. Single account only, no rotation.
geminiOauth.managed_notice: Manage the Gemini subscription provider in Settings → Providers. Generic edit/delete cannot change its name, URL, credentials or transformer. Use Disconnect there to remove it; Router is unchanged.
geminiOauth.other_edit: Finish the current provider edit/save before managing the Gemini subscription provider.
geminiOauth.login_pending: Waiting for authorization. Finish signing in on the Google page that just opened. This attempt ends after at most ten minutes.
geminiOauth.login_success: Signed in as {{email}} — Gemini models registered. Router unchanged.
geminiOauth.login_success_unknown: Signed in and registered Gemini models. Router unchanged.
geminiOauth.synced_cleared: Registered {{count}} Gemini models and cleared {{refs}} from Router.
geminiOauth.synced_kept: Model sync failed, the previous model list is kept.
geminiOauth.disconnected: Gemini subscription disconnected. The local credential file was deleted; Router changes were applied as reported.
geminiOauth.disconnect_warning: CCR deletes its private credential file and the managed provider. Router references that pointed at it are removed wherever the server reports them; other routes stay untouched. You can authorize again at any time.
geminiOauth.needs_relogin_help: The saved login was rejected upstream. Authorize again to continue.
geminiOauth.risk_title: Confirm the risk before signing in
geminiOauth.risk: Using a third-party tool with a Google subscription to reach Antigravity breaches its terms. Google may suspend the account (first offenses can be appealed via Google's form; a second violation is permanent). Only use an account you can afford to lose. Continue?
geminiOauth.risk_ack: I have read this warning and use an account I can afford to lose.
geminiOauth.about_body: Tokens are stored only in CCR's private server file (0600), never in this page, the provider configuration or its logs. This provider is experimental: Google actively detects third-party clients and may suspend the account.
geminiOauth.no_content_obfuscation: CCR never rewrites prompts or identities to disguise the client. Requests identified as third-party are reported as such, not retried.
geminiOauth.single_account: v1 keeps exactly one account. No automatic rotation and no pool: switching accounts does not work around a suspension.

errors.gemini_oauth_identity_blocked: Google rejected this request as a third-party Claude client (not a quota problem). The account is parked for 6 hours; retrying does not help.
errors.gemini_oauth_validation_required: Google requires account verification. Open the link below on the official site to verify, then retry. The account is parked for 30 minutes.
errors.gemini_oauth_quota_exceeded: The subscription quota was exhausted. The account is parked until it resets.
errors.gemini_oauth_reauth_required: The saved login was rejected. Authorize again to continue.
errors.gemini_oauth_upstream_error: The upstream service returned an error. Check the CCR logs and retry later.
errors.gemini_oauth_not_connected: No Gemini subscription account is connected. Authorize first.
errors.gemini_oauth_login_busy: Another authorization attempt is running. Wait for it to finish and start again.
errors.gemini_oauth_name_conflict: An ordinary provider named “gemini-oauth” already exists. Rename or remove it first; CCR will not take it over.
errors.gemini_oauth_login_state_rejected: This authorization attempt expired or was rejected. Start a new one.
errors.gemini_oauth_login_account_failed: The authorized account could not be confirmed. Start a new login.
errors.gemini_oauth_login_persist_failed: The login could not be saved privately on the CCR server. Check the server and retry.
errors.gemini_oauth_models_fetch_failed: Model discovery failed or returned nothing. The previous model list is preserved.
errors.gemini_oauth_config_write_failed: The change was rolled back because the configuration could not be saved. Check the CCR server config and retry.
errors.request_failed: The Gemini subscription request failed. No success was confirmed; retry explicitly.
errors.config_busy: A configuration save or another managed-provider action is in progress. Wait for it to finish and retry.
